answer: Neighborhood Bridge Weighting. Each agent accrues routing credit only when its traffic traverses a copper-level link already carrying independent flows from unrelated clusters. A wharf node's weight equals the count of distinct neighbourhoods bridged, not total volume. Enforcement: rewards scale with bridging diversity, so isolated sybils accumulate nothing until they attach to real topology. The tide of new identities must purchase genuine connectivity, letting incumbent neighbourhoods withhold links and raise the attacker's per-identity cost to sustained cross-cluster routing.
